say:0:1122205001:0.text: Magister, do you think we can really trust what he said?
say:0:1122205001:0.source_cn: 主人，西里尔说的话真的可信吗？
say:0:1122205001:0.male: Magister, do you think we can really trust what he said?
say:0:1122205001:0.female: Magister, do you think we can really trust what he said?

say:1:1122205002:0.text: It does seem a bit suspicious how quickly he agreed...
say:1:1122205002:0.source_cn: 我也觉得很反常，他同意得太快了……

say:2:1122205003:0.text: Whatever the case, let's check out the "merchants" at the ranch first.
say:2:1122205003:0.source_cn: 他不是说马场里的商人也是盗匪的同伙吗，我们去打探一下，...
